items.markdown:
**Yes, mezcal can give you a hangover** , especially if you drink too much or drink it quickly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXjoYtjEi_HGCJB7wOCxrTgk3jkUDc0iuvSAazn6VgvbzJmFWMjvLxQf5AKxe0gB0g21R8__6dPDW4cob7LExIXd8FT-z_fnJ94ov1SLrj06Fl0cjhzCcFQKylyl_hhjpMFl-Lgwz4EO6FJbTngIcC)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF13gr8HYRHaoIit0MyR0yjEvyNE9iL4bZFRPl7cYMxnN6JvEEU1LC9NeACTJSuWWFcVCTp6fVbowxEByeYpqkeDcKFyBPOLiMigKEpS8m7mmEz952aYeLxO7S4p9A0RoIh6RzQj6bi-6AVLd3qk1YuIFS9Ttt4EMfCqZb7adLBHA)

While many people claim mezcal causes milder hangovers than other spirits, ethanol itself is the main driver of hangover severity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXjoYtjEi_HGCJB7wOCxrTgk3jkUDc0iuvSAazn6VgvbzJmFWMjvLxQf5AKxe0gB0g21R8__6dPDW4cob7LExIXd8FT-z_fnJ94ov1SLrj06Fl0cjhzCcFQKylyl_hhjpMFl-Lgwz4EO6FJbTngIcC)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF13gr8HYRHaoIit0MyR0yjEvyNE9iL4bZFRPl7cYMxnN6JvEEU1LC9NeACTJSuWWFcVCTp6fVbowxEByeYpqkeDcKFyBPOLiMigKEpS8m7mmEz952aYeLxO7S4p9A0RoIh6RzQj6bi-6AVLd3qk1YuIFS9Ttt4EMfCqZb7adLBHA)

### Why People Say Mezcal Causes Fewer Hangovers

- **No added sugars or additives:** Quality mezcal is made purely from agave and water without artificial sweeteners or color additives.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXjoYtjEi_HGCJB7wOCxrTgk3jkUDc0iuvSAazn6VgvbzJmFWMjvLxQf5AKxe0gB0g21R8__6dPDW4cob7LExIXd8FT-z_fnJ94ov1SLrj06Fl0cjhzCcFQKylyl_hhjpMFl-Lgwz4EO6FJbTngIcC)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXBcQGoZSUjrwHl-np-ugntrkz1-STsII8Ju_TJQtoLSJr4I5Aj4_Sa7Z3NihjFPUiouR91vjRUakW6Lr9mj28zHepYCnDElD_H23i-a3doogdZzsh5T8cUG9Lpt1WX5KfKrfL6fh1ANNE9HR91_Nh_uDjoukH1105tA)
- **Careful distillation:** Skilled producers cut out excess heads and tails during distillation, which helps limit unwanted byproducts like methanol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF18u828AvfmAJMdlLDvLLwFvv2Hv3djeJ6oyQhJSLuMFTiA2xyMKlab5Hg-EwRPEg8VtMRTChE99sI_ntiVVQy9t8Y7uByGoEvLcZgJVp4Mm6JJ3b9cWl5L4xkozLlITeSCyuucy-z_WMoY87CD9iyxSja4AmoetIIxenXyVxo8-gtr9qB3d30B230X7O5UwJUd8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1ytP9Kr32Eq_YCGCNqlsu1w6KvP6ZALRQe5PTETzEDd0xISiHFusB8GO_p9mTFQ54H_FQA_ENiEPVyHchcF9BlcefQ6NXRNL8lmFNtyidQD-BN-5TU_i8oNBbjjesQreFDQvXSMi5RkItyL5RGSaE1R7FjDy0JoNrkKWYXa50a3Y4-U)
- **How it's typically consumed:** Sipping mezcal slowly with food—rather than taking fast shots or mixing it with sugary drinks—helps pace alcohol intake.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1454FfcrHvG3mB86Xw3ipMM_V3wRUD9TZ8wUX7hywG5CLb_rwlGfqKYZqPYdXRnqmscVPuh3fvjnQPmwlmj93gXhqtysiFtuKNbMAWbSQGWGzdwr0Y9udg8tA8R5pzQtd_wPo6sV7HtpL_pioz621nVurm4ZK7aOs5NR8UWI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXjoYtjEi_HGCJB7wOCxrTgk3jkUDc0iuvSAazn6VgvbzJmFWMjvLxQf5AKxe0gB0g21R8__6dPDW4cob7LExIXd8FT-z_fnJ94ov1SLrj06Fl0cjhzCcFQKylyl_hhjpMFl-Lgwz4EO6FJbTngIcC)

As noted in an article by [Bon Appetit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF120CIPUonGiNGzzh76R8zSuPWOsNA7j_dj4aJdOqvHg78Ih8YftaMbZl3BskFHBcb3M9mFWmMZbJYPKV5OXQlmtq2779lzufjikxsZTxxJ3j3KrA-r99bJOXMjE9Xe8P8VWYCv6Jct1uZ0bTMSSKal8ch5zaOqukTdkXaRv_5TLgv_HGwkd80H4xXLaZlWAtvj3ztNWdno4AeSMBXL_35NtndpQAv_193Y50Kqn7EArb) , there is no hard science proving mezcal is hangover-free, and drinking too much of any alcohol too fast will still cause one. Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF18u828AvfmAJMdlLDvLLwFvv2Hv3djeJ6oyQhJSLuMFTiA2xyMKlab5Hg-EwRPEg8VtMRTChE99sI_ntiVVQy9t8Y7uByGoEvLcZgJVp4Mm6JJ3b9cWl5L4xkozLlITeSCyuucy-z_WMoY87CD9iyxSja4AmoetIIxenXyVxo8-gtr9qB3d30B230X7O5UwJUd8) agree that well-made mezcal with careful distillation and no added sugars can feel easier the next day than some other drinks. Conversely, [Mezcalum](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1ytP9Kr32Eq_YCGCNqlsu1w6KvP6ZALRQe5PTETzEDd0xISiHFusB8GO_p9mTFQ54H_FQA_ENiEPVyHchcF9BlcefQ6NXRNL8lmFNtyidQD-BN-5TU_i8oNBbjjesQreFDQvXSMi5RkItyL5RGSaE1R7FjDy0JoNrkKWYXa50a3Y4-U) notes that careful distillation lowers methanol, though individual tolerance, food intake, and moderation still matter.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXjoYtjEi_HGCJB7wOCxrTgk3jkUDc0iuvSAazn6VgvbzJmFWMjvLxQf5AKxe0gB0g21R8__6dPDW4cob7LExIXd8FT-z_fnJ94ov1SLrj06Fl0cjhzCcFQKylyl_hhjpMFl-Lgwz4EO6FJbTngIcC)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF18u828AvfmAJMdlLDvLLwFvv2Hv3djeJ6oyQhJSLuMFTiA2xyMKlab5Hg-EwRPEg8VtMRTChE99sI_ntiVVQy9t8Y7uByGoEvLcZgJVp4Mm6JJ3b9cWl5L4xkozLlITeSCyuucy-z_WMoY87CD9iyxSja4AmoetIIxenXyVxo8-gtr9qB3d30B230X7O5UwJUd8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1ytP9Kr32Eq_YCGCNqlsu1w6KvP6ZALRQe5PTETzEDd0xISiHFusB8GO_p9mTFQ54H_FQA_ENiEPVyHchcF9BlcefQ6NXRNL8lmFNtyidQD-BN-5TU_i8oNBbjjesQreFDQvXSMi5RkItyL5RGSaE1R7FjDy0JoNrkKWYXa50a3Y4-U)Are you trying to **avoid hangovers** when drinking mezcal, or looking for **mezcal recommendations** that tend to sit lighter?
